Fast terminal (restty/WebGPU over a Rust PTY), CodeMirror 6 editor, fi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"le explorer, markdown notes, sandboxed browser, and ripgrep search — all as tabs in dockable right a"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"nd bottom panels. Extendable with your own React components."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-powerdesk"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DSH web plugin that adds a small IDE
workbench to the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated **terminal**, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"a **file
explorer**, a **notes** app, a **code editor**, a sandboxed **browser**, and a
**calendar**"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" — all self-contained, in a dockable right panel *and* a dockable
bottom panel (VSCode-style dual wo"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"rkbench, with drag-to-split and
drag-between-panels)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Terminal** — rendered with restty
(WebGPU/WebGL2 + WASM VT, Ghostty-lineage) and backed by a **R"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ust PTY**
(napi-rs + portable-pty)
instead of the C++ `node-pty` the stock terminal uses.
- **Explor"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"er** — a directory tree over any local folder you bookmark (picked
via a built-in folder-browser mod"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"al, not a text field). Click a file to open
it in the editor; each file row has quick "copy relative"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" path" (for
@-mentioning in chat) and "copy absolute path" actions.
- **Notes** — bind one local fol"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"der and browse/edit only its `.md` files as a
recursive tree, with inline create / rename / delete f"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"or both notes and
folders. The editor is embedded in the same tab (tree left, editor right).
- **Edi"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"tor** — CodeMirror 6 with syntax
highlighting for TS/JS/Python/JSON/CSS/HTML/Markdown/Rust/YAML, a
s"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"electable CodeMirror theme (Dracula by default), soft line-wrapping, and
Cmd/Ctrl+S save. Opens auto"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"matically when you click a file in Explorer or
Notes.
- **Browser** — a sandboxed iframe behind an a"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"ddress bar, with an
embeddability probe that explains `X-Frame-Options` / `frame-ancestors`
refusals"},{"id":"p5s12","text":" instead of showing a blank "refused to connect" frame.
- **Calendar** — a schedule-x calendar (Mont"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"h / Week
/ Day) over a local SQLite database (a new Rust napi module with bundled
SQLite, sibling to"},{"id":"p5s14","text":" the PTY crate), lazy-loaded so it never weighs down
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why Powerdesk"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **A genuinely fast terminal** — restty (WebGPU/WebGL2 + a WASM VT, Ghostty-lineage) over a **Rust"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" PTY** (napi-rs + portable-pty), not the C++ `node-pty` the stock terminal uses — so terminal I/O is"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" substantially faster and lighter.
2. **A full IDE without leaving the chat** — ripgrep content sear"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ch, a CodeMirror 6 editor, a file explorer, notes, and a sandboxed browser, all as tabs in dockable "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"right + bottom panels. Never context-switch out of the DSH page.
3. **Two-panel VSCode-style workben"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ch** — drag any tab to a pane edge to split it, or between the right and bottom panels to move it en"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"tirely; two split trees sharing one drag-and-drop system.
4. **Zero-build install** — `lib/` and the"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" macOS / Linux-x64 Rust PTY binaries are committed, so `dsh plugin add` just copies files: no build "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"step, no Rust toolchain, no `allowBuilds` entry.
5. **Build your own tabs** — ship a React component"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" + a `powerdesk.json` as a `.tgz` and it mounts as a sidebar tab; a template (`templates/extension/`"},{"id":"p7s11","text":") gets you to `pnpm pack` in minutes.
6. **Sandboxed by default** — the browser tab runs without `al"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"low-same-origin`, refuses loopback addresses, and probes `X-Frame-Options` / `frame-ancestors` to ex"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"plain refusals instead of showing a blank frame."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Quick install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires DSH `>=0.0.1` with the `dsh` CLI on your `PATH`. Hard-refresh the browser (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R"},{"id":"p10s2","text":") after installing. The terminal works out of the box on macOS (both architectures) and Linux x86_64"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"; other platforms build the Rust PTY once on first use (see Install)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **DSH** `>=0.0.1` with the `dsh` CLI on your `PATH` (`dsh --version`). Loads into a DSH profile (d"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"efault `web`).
- **Node.js 20+** and **pnpm 9+** if you install from source.
- **A Rust toolchain** "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"(`rustup`) — only if your platform has no committed prebuilt binary yet; macOS users never need Rust"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"`rustup`) — only if your platform has no committed prebuilt binary yet; macOS users never need Rust."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The PTY addon is looked up by platform triple (`src/rust-pty-deps.ts`). Three triples have a binary "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"committed to the repo and shipped with every install; the rest build from source on first use:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| OS | Arch | Triple | Prebuilt? |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| macOS | Apple Silicon | `darwin-arm64` | ✅ committed |
| macOS | Intel | `darwin-x64` | ✅ committe"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"d |
| Linux | x86_64 (glibc) | `linux-x64-gnu` | ✅ committed |
| Linux | aarch64 (glibc) | `linux-ar"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"m64-gnu` | build from source |
| Windows | x86_64 | `win32-x64-msvc` | build from source |
| Windows"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" | ARM64 | `win32-arm64-msvc` | build from source |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Pick **one** channel — do not enable both (they would double-mount the host half and render two side"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"bars). No npm package is published yet, so both install straight from the GitHub repo."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Option A — from GitHub (recommended)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The repo is public, so the plain HTTPS URL works anonymously. pnpm reads the package name out of the"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" repo, so no `dsh-powerdesk@` prefix is needed — though `dsh-powerdesk@<url>` lets you pin a branch "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"or tag (`...git#my-branch`). Prefer SSH? `git+ssh://git@github.com/FleetingEcho/dsh-powerdesk.git` w"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"orks too (needs an SSH key on GitHub)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`lib/` (the built client/host JS) and the macOS / Linux-x64 Rust PTY binaries are committed, so ther"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e's no build step and no `allowBuilds` entry — the terminal works immediately on those platforms."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Windows or Linux ARM64: build the Rust PTY once"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Option B — from source (for development)"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Security — read this first"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"An extension runs **in the DSH page's own origin**, with full access to the DOM, your session, and t"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"he network — the same privileges as Powerdesk itself. There is no sandbox (and cannot be one while e"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"xtensions share the host's React instance). This is a **trusted local extensions** feature, not a ma"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"rketplace: install only code you have read or whose author you trust.
